mechanism: Oxybutynin is a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor which may increase rosuvastatin exposure, while rosuvastatin has minimal hepatic metabolism making this interaction clinically modest; additive effects on muscle via statin-anticholinergic mechanisms may increase myopathy risk.
action: Monitor for signs of statin myopathy (muscle pain, weakness); consider rosuvastatin dose adjustment if oxybutynin is initiated or discontinued; educate patient on reporting muscle symptoms.
